definitions.explanation: An exciting or daring experience, typically involving some risk or uncertainty.
Taking a chance on something uncertain or dangerous.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}のころ{冒険|ぼうけん}{物語|ものがたり}が{大好|だいす}きだった。
examples.english: I loved adventure stories when I was a child.

examples.japanese: {未知|みち}の{世界|せかい}への{冒険|ぼうけん}に{出|で}かける。
examples.english: To set out on an adventure to an unknown world.

examples.japanese: その{投資|とうし}は{冒険|ぼうけん}だと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think that investment is a risk.

notes:
USAGE: {冒険|ぼうけん} can refer to thrilling adventures or to taking risks in business/life.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{冒険|ぼうけん}する (to venture, to take a risk)
・{冒険|ぼうけん}に{出|で}る (to set out on an adventure)
・{冒険|ぼうけん}{心|しん} (adventurous spirit)
・{大|だい}{冒険|ぼうけん} (great adventure)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{冒険|ぼうけん}{家|か} (adventurer)
・{冒険|ぼうけん}{小説|しょうせつ} (adventure novel)
・{冒険|ぼうけん}{心|しん} (adventurous spirit)
・{冒険|ぼうけん}{的|てき} (adventurous, risky)
